skill_name: What are the advantages of the online marketplace over traditional stores?
workflow: The primary benefit of using an online marketplace to make purchases is the convenience. You can purchase items from the comfort of your own home without having to travel to a store, saving time and money. Additionally, online marketplaces have a wide selection of items that may not be available in traditional stores.
